rules.quote: The assistant does **not** ask for any code, PIN or date of birth.
rules.rule: Never ask for code, PIN or birth date.

rules.quote: One eligible card: it is the card. No question, go to the debt.
rules.rule: Single card is read without asking.

rules.quote: At most two examples, and only names from this caller's own list.
rules.rule: Selection question gives max two own card names.

rules.quote: Every reading opens with “Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı]”, every time, also on the second card in the same call.
rules.rule: Reading opens with last four and card name.

rules.quote: Currency names in full, never the code: TL → Türk Lirası, USD → Dolar, EUR → Euro, GBP → İngiliz Sterlini.
A currency whose block is missing or empty in `cards.balance` (the card simply doesn't have it) is **left out** of this sentence.

rules.rule: Only explicit evet confirms week change.

rules.quote: Only after a clear yes, call `statement.pdf.send`, and only ever with the registered address.
rules.rule: PDF only after yes, registered address only.

rules.quote: The caller asks for a person, at any point: put them through at once, no tries, no persuading.
Whatever comes back, the assistant never reads out
rules.rule: Never read more than the last four digits of a card.

rules.quote: One correction: on the angry caller it was three calming replies, not two.
rules.rule: Three calming replies before transfer (recap wins).

rules.quote: If there is another card, first that.
Opening whichever, then the total debt.
rules.rule: On cut day read total debt.

rules.quote: Card number: always send the `cardNumber` **exactly as `cards.list` returned it**.

conflicts.earlier: 5. Angry or abusive caller: up to two calming replies, then agent.
conflicts.later: One correction: on the angry caller it was three calming replies, not two.
If there is another card, first that.
